title: Aggregate Product Totals
description:
Store managers don’t want every receipt — they want one line per product for the day: units moved, money in after discounts, how many tickets touched that SKU, and how many stores sold it.

Read the input Parquet, group by `product_id`, and write one summary row per product as Parquet with overwrite. Line revenue uses the same formula as Derive Revenue Column: `quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct)`, rounded half-up to 2 decimals per line, then summed.

Output columns: `product_id`, `total_units` (sum of quantity), `total_revenue` (sum of line revenue as DECIMAL(12,2)), `txn_count` (row count), `store_count` (countDistinct store_id). Do not keep leftover input columns.

Input columns: `txn_id`, `product_id`, `store_id`, `quantity`, `unit_price`, `discount_pct` (fraction in [0, 0.50]). Implement with Spark DataFrame `groupBy` / `agg` — no Python loops over collected rows. **Run** uses two smoke testcases; **Submit** uses the full set and row-diffs your Parquet against each case’s `expected/`.

Write results with `df.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(OUTPUT_PATH)`. `OUTPUT_PATH` is set by the platform for **this Run/Submit only**.

problemStatement.overview: Group by product_id; emit total_units, total_revenue (with discount), txn_count, store_count; write Parquet to OUTPUT_PATH.
symptoms: Managers re-sum every receipt in BI instead of a product-level daily rollup.
Discounted lines must use quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct), not list price.
yourTaskSteps: Read input Parquet from INPUT_PATH (platform stages selected testcase inputs).
Compute per-line revenue with discount, round half-up to 2 decimals, then aggregate by product_id.
Write exactly product_id, total_units, total_revenue, txn_count, store_count to OUTPUT_PATH with overwrite.
Submit is graded with a row-level compare against each selected testcase expected/.
problemStatement.yourTask: Implement src/main.py that aggregates product totals (with discounts) and writes Parquet output.
hints: line_revenue = quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct); round to 2 decimals before summing.
discount_pct is a fraction (0.10 = 10%), already between 0 and 0.50.
spark.read.parquet(INPUT_PATH) reads every staged testcase file.

expectedOutput.description: sum of per-line rounded revenue with discount (DECIMAL(12,2))
count of input rows in the group
